minimalCentralWrap.extent: central x=-42..42; full thickness y=-12.5..12.5; crown z=27.5..30
minimalCentralWrap.implementation: Move Face30 from nature_pinch to nature_jug with the existing pinch-60 additional contact membership. Face44 is bottom-back and must stay pinch-only.
minimalCentralWrap.sufficiency: Completes central front/top/back round. Does not wrap the two upper end shoulders.

recommendedRoundedCrown.extent: Existing upper outer rounds through their natural native tangent boundaries at z=22; cord-groove cutouts remain cutouts, their recessed walls remain body.
recommendedRoundedCrown.implementation: Keep shared crown faces30/43/69 in nature_jug. Use a separate native jug-only binder/node for upper end rounds28/29/41/42/59/65, so these new jug-only surfaces do not expand the logical pinch union.
recommendedRoundedCrown.reason: Covers the complete continuous pre-existing rounded crown with no guessed grip-height boundary or native split. Manufacturer whole front/reverse views show these rounded upper shoulders; contact assignment is a display interpretation of the user-identified upper rail.

uprightBands.warning: Neither entire face is an upper rail: front18 includes side/lower frame and back70 is the entire rear panel. Never select either whole face.
uprightBands.possibleNativeBoundary: If a deeper front/back upright wrap is explicitly requested, split these surfaces at z=22 (the existing upper shoulder tangent elevation). Their upper bands then meet the whole upper crown, leaving the lower frame/rear body unselected. This 8mm top-band depth would be an operator-selected display estimate, not a manufacturer grip depth.
uprightBands.recommendation: Do not add upright bands in the minimal correction unless clarified scope requires deeper wrap. Existing actual central front rail extends to the recessed-mouth lip at z19.824; selecting the whole rail would also require deliberate treatment of curved end joins and shared wood lip surfaces.
